rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Beautiful Dreamer
rows.Origin:
Bred by Dr. Keith W. Zary (United States, 2014).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (post 1970) in 2014 as 'Beautiful Dreamer'.
rows.Bloom: Coral. None to mild, fruity, licorice fragrance. 40 to 45 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Glossy, dark green, leathery foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 47" to 4'11" (120 to 150cm). Width: 4" to 47" (10 to 120cm).
